Note 1.
The company allotted 69,456 equity shares of Rs. 5 each pursuant to exercise of ESOP Scheme 2021 and ESOP Scheme 2023 on June 24, 2026. Consequently, the paid-up equity share capital of the Company increased from Rs. 54,39,25,495 comprising 10,87,85,099 Equity Shares to Rs. 54,42,72,775 comprising 10,88,54,555 Equity Shares. However, the corporate action in respect of the said allotment, along with final listing and trading approval from the Stock Exchanges, was completed on July 02, 2026. Therefore, the shares allotted were not reflected in the BENPOS report as of June 30, 2026, provided by the Registrar and Share Transfer Agent (RTA).
Note 2.

(Promoter Group) was reclassified with effect from May 21, 2026, being the date of receipt of /NOC's from BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited.

Note 3.
Pursuant to certain refinancing facilities availed by the Company from the National Housing Bank (NHB) and the related documentation, Westbridge Crossover Fund, LLC and Aravali Investment Holdings, the promoter of the Company, has furnished an undertaking to the NHB for non-disposal of its shareholding in the Company as specified above.
Note 4
